text: Once a king thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That he would never fail. <break time="0.8s" /> In anything. <break time="0.8s" /> If he knew three things. <break time="0.8s" /> He wanted to know. <break time="0.8s" /> The right time. <break time="0.8s" /> To begin every task. <break time="0.8s" /> And the right people. <break time="0.8s" /> To listen to. <break time="0.8s" /> Above all. <break time="0.8s" /> He wanted to know. <break time="0.8s" /> Which work. <break time="0.8s" /> Was the most important of all. <break time="0.8s" /> So he sent a message. <break time="0.8s" /> Throughout his kingdom. <break time="0.8s" /> Promising a great reward. <break time="0.8s" /> To anyone. <break time="0.8s" /> Who could teach him these things. <break time="0.8s" /> Many learned men. <break time="0.8s" /> Came to the king. <break time="0.8s" /> But they all gave. <break time="0.8s" /> Different answers. <break time="0.8s" /> Some said that he should make a careful timetable. <break time="0.8s" /> Of days, months, and years. <break time="0.8s" /> And follow it strictly. <break time="0.8s" /> Others said that he should always pay attention. <break time="0.8s" /> To what was happening. <break time="0.8s" /> And do what was most needed. <break time="0.8s" /> Still others said that he needed a council of wise men. <break time="0.8s" /> And some even said. <break time="0.8s" /> He should ask magicians. <break time="0.8s" /> To the second question. <break time="0.8s" /> Some answered that his advisers were the most important. <break time="0.8s" /> While others named. <break time="0.8s" /> Priests, doctors, or soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> To the third question. <break time="0.8s" /> Some said science. <break time="0.8s" /> Some said skill in war. <break time="0.8s" /> And others said the worship of God. <break time="0.8s" /> The answers were so different. <break time="0.8s" /> That the king agreed with none of them. <break time="0.8s" /> And gave nobody the reward.
